en.headline: SMH is the main reason the portfolio trails its benchmark
en.what_happened: The model portfolio fell 0.21% this week, against -0.47% for the benchmark (70% SPY / 30% AGG). Since 7 August 2026 it returned -1.16% against 1.39%, a shortfall of 2.54 percentage points.
en.why: The largest effect came from SMH: -2.87 percentage points (weight 27.0%, own return -10.23%). The strongest contribution came from GSG: +0.99 percentage points.
en.what_we_do: The rules lead to 6 trades this week; 6 new positions follow in the coming weeks because of the limit of 2 fund changes per week. The European mirror has returned -0.24% since 7 August 2026, against -1.16% for the US portfolio.
